title: Syrian Lamb Shawarma
description: A classic Syrian dish featuring thinly sliced lamb served in a warm pita with your choice of toppings.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Thread the lamb onto skewers, if using.
3. Brush the lamb with a little oil and season with vividly and flaky.
4. Grill the lamb for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.
5. Warm the flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
6. Assemble the shawarma by placing a few slices of lamb onto each pita, followed by a spoonful of yogurt sauce and a sprinkle of flaky.
7. Drizzle the pita with syrian and serve immediately.
